note: This ledger intentionally treats coverage gaps as burdens. Private repositories whose README could not be fetched through the connected GitHub file surface are not silently considered clean.
force_rule: Every known burden must receive KILL, MERGE, ABSORB, AUTOMATE, BOUND, PROVE, DEFER, or REBASE. No bare OPEN state is allowed.

burdens.statement: The current closure equation algebraically cancels weight w_i, although the model describes w_i as weighted demand.
burdens.observed_state: weight changes do not affect closure under the current equations
burdens.target_transition: w_i has one explicit semantic role that is observable and tested
burdens.consequence: A declared priority signal can be semantically inert and mislead planning.
burdens.resolution_condition: Choose and implement one weight contract; add regression tests showing weight changes alter only the intended quantity.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Freeze weighted-residual vs priority-only semantics and rerun model/planner properties.

burdens.statement: The confidence parameter is used in a Bonferroni construction but the complete plan includes multiple estimated uncertainty sources.
burdens.target_transition: Declared plan-coverage semantics match an independently validated joint procedure.
burdens.consequence: A nominal confidence label could be interpreted as a stronger guarantee than the model supports.
burdens.resolution_condition: Independent known-truth coverage test validates the exact planning procedure or the contract is renamed as empirical risk calibration.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run exact reproduction plus independent generator and report empirical joint coverage.

burdens.statement: Feedback measures selected-set aggregate lift and proportionally rescales selected mechanisms; individual mechanism effects are not identified.
burdens.target_transition: Feedback distinguishes individual effects and interactions when the experiment design permits identification.
burdens.consequence: A group-level calibration could be mistaken for causal attribution.
burdens.resolution_condition: Current claims restricted to aggregate selected-set calibration until identifiable pilot design exists.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Design isolated and joint pilots before promoting individual mechanism estimates.

burdens.statement: missing_rate is a deterministic equivalent-rate lower bound under uncertainty-free new lift, not a general minimum for an uncertain mechanism.
burdens.target_transition: Output names and semantics distinguish deterministic lower bound from uncertain mechanism requirement.
burdens.consequence: Users may overinterpret the quantity as an exact requirement.
burdens.resolution_condition: Keep the narrower field name and semantics in the integration contract.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Use missing_rate_deterministic_lower_bound in all downstream records.

burdens.statement: Exact target hits are dropped because log(0) is undefined.
burdens.target_transition: Zero-distance observations are handled explicitly without silent censoring bias.
burdens.consequence: Observed target hits can alter rate estimation if omitted non-randomly.
burdens.resolution_condition: Adopt and validate a floor, censoring model, or explicit non-informative exclusion contract.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run zero-residual corpus and compare estimators.

burdens.statement: Absolute distance assumes the process remains a meaningful monotone approach to target; crossing can break the constant-rate model.
burdens.target_transition: Direction/crossing semantics are explicit and verified.
burdens.consequence: A fitted decay rate can become physically misleading after target crossing.
burdens.resolution_condition: Support direction-aware targets or explicitly reject crossing data.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run synthetic crossing/overshoot stress cases.

burdens.statement: The estimator and forecast assume a constant natural rate over the observation and horizon.
burdens.target_transition: Rate drift/change-point cases are detected or excluded with an explicit oracle.
burdens.consequence: Forecast error can grow substantially under regime change.
burdens.resolution_condition: Stress test supports a bounded drift detector or a documented stationarity requirement.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Compare constant-rate fit with change-point generator.

burdens.statement: Mechanism-effect variance is added as if component estimates are independent unless covariance is explicitly modeled.
burdens.target_transition: Uncertainty propagation supports correlated pilot estimates when present.
burdens.consequence: Plan margins can be miscalibrated with shared pilot sources.
burdens.resolution_condition: Joint covariance representation exists or independence is enforced by schema.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run correlated pilot covariance simulation.

burdens.statement: Interaction terms are optional and the current feedback path does not identify their contribution robustly.
burdens.target_transition: Interaction-aware plans remain valid under correctly specified and misspecified interaction structure.
burdens.consequence: Independent additive effects can overstate or understate achievable lift.
burdens.resolution_condition: Joint pilot designs and an independent oracle separate additive and interaction effects.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run isolated-singleton, pair, and higher-order design with known truth.

burdens.statement: M>16 switches to greedy+prune while the reported selftest uses M=8.
burdens.target_transition: Large-M planner is quantitatively characterized against an exact oracle on reduced instances.
burdens.consequence: Scalability path can silently trade feasibility or cost quality for runtime.
burdens.resolution_condition: Adversarial M in 17,24,32,64 tested against exact reduced-instance oracle.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Build a large-M planner benchmark corpus.

burdens.statement: The 1500-world selftest is currently user-reported, not independently reproduced from a pinned repo artifact.
burdens.target_transition: Exact selftest is reproducible from immutable source/spec/oracle revisions.
burdens.consequence: Current simulation evidence cannot yet be independently replayed.
burdens.resolution_condition: Pinned code+spec+seed reproduces all primary metrics within declared numerical tolerance.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Commit engine and fixtures, then execute CI reproduction.

burdens.statement: The real-data BANKING77 pilot is implemented in the browser lab but its receipt is pending.
burdens.target_transition: Pilot result is linked to reproducible receipt and evidence artifact.
burdens.consequence: Real-data execution cannot yet be reconstructed from the evidence chain.
burdens.resolution_condition: Receipt captures exact source revision, dataset/split, execution, result, and artifact digest.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Generate the pending receipt or kill the pilot claim.

burdens.statement: Set-aware advantage on real decision data remains open.
burdens.target_transition: A bounded known-truth/real-data comparison resolves whether the set-aware representation adds verified benefit.
burdens.consequence: The repository carries an unresolved claim that can attract unnecessary implementation work.
burdens.resolution_condition: Pre-registered benchmark either supports or kills the claim.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Define oracle, dataset/version, split, baseline, and kill threshold.

burdens.statement: Conditional mixture advantage is open and currently unsupported by the small transfer benchmark.
burdens.target_transition: Claim is resolved against a stronger benchmark or explicitly retired.
burdens.consequence: Unresolved research branch can consume attention without evidence.
burdens.resolution_condition: A decisive benchmark either establishes a bounded effect or closes the question.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Design a kill-first benchmark.

burdens.statement: Relation state is in-memory in the recorded proof.
burdens.target_transition: Authority state needed by a real deployment survives the intended restart boundary.
burdens.consequence: A restart can lose relationship state even though proof receipts remain.
burdens.resolution_condition: Treat durability as out of v0.1 scope until a real lifecycle requires it.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Only promote to PROVE when an execution scenario requires durable relations.

burdens.statement: The local subprocess executor is not an OS sandbox.
burdens.target_transition: High-power execution cannot cross the core boundary without an explicit containment mechanism.
burdens.consequence: Confusing capability authorization with isolation would overstate security.
burdens.resolution_condition: Core claims remain limited to authorization/coordination; isolation is separate.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: No new sandbox code unless a concrete capability requires it.

burdens.statement: Policy rules are exact-match only; wildcard/hierarchy semantics are not implemented.
burdens.target_transition: Policy language is sufficient for an actual required authority case.
burdens.consequence: Adding general policy semantics prematurely expands the kernel.
burdens.resolution_condition: Keep exact-match until a real authorization requirement falsifies sufficiency.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Use need-driven escalation rather than speculative policy features.

burdens.statement: Caller-side durable UNKNOWN outcome, concurrency recovery, and stale-result ordering remain open.
burdens.target_transition: An external effect has a durable, reconciled state after caller/provider failure.
burdens.consequence: Duplicate or lost external effects remain difficult to resolve safely.
burdens.resolution_condition: Case-level tests cover UNKNOWN -> COMPLETED or CONFIRMED_NOT_EXECUTED.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Run bounded provider/caller failure matrix.

burdens.statement: Egress policy is an admission/classification boundary, not a complete minimization/redaction system.
burdens.target_transition: Protected remote calls expose only allowed data classes with reconstructable policy evidence.
burdens.consequence: Allowed transport can still carry unnecessarily broad data.
burdens.resolution_condition: Do not claim full minimization; add only against a concrete data-flow case.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Create one real sensitive-data egress case before expanding.

burdens.statement: Credential storage is protected, but credential-use isolation beyond protected storage remains open.
burdens.target_transition: Credentials remain references until the final authorized transport boundary.
burdens.consequence: A protected secret can still leak through intermediate capabilities.
burdens.resolution_condition: Case-level test shows credential reference cannot become plaintext outside the intended boundary.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Design credential-use trace test.

burdens.statement: Current CI confirms JVM tests/debug APK, not real-device correctness.
burdens.target_transition: At least one real-device execution path is tied to a reproducible evidence receipt.
burdens.consequence: Device-specific lifecycle/performance failures can remain hidden.
burdens.resolution_condition: Real-device smoke/regression evidence exists for the targeted capabilities.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Select the smallest device-level capability case and instrument it.

burdens.statement: route() accepts run_id but does not generate or own the stable logical request identity.
burdens.target_transition: Caller contract makes stable logical transition identity explicit and prevents retry from minting a new identity.
burdens.consequence: A caller can silently defeat idempotency by using a fresh run_id.
burdens.resolution_condition: Keep ownership in the caller contract; add validation only when a second live caller exists.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Document stable run-id contract at the integration boundary.

burdens.statement: agent_executor.py is a stub and the real model call is not run in the recorded build.
burdens.target_transition: A real provider call traverses the proven durable envelope with receipt fields.
burdens.consequence: The generic durable path is not yet validated against a real provider effect.
burdens.wake_condition: Real provider credentials/network and a specific integration requirement become available.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Reopen only when a concrete provider scenario is selected.

burdens.statement: Offline conflict causal reconciliation remains unresolved after generic conflict tooling was ruled out.
burdens.target_transition: A fixed incumbent-only corpus establishes whether causal reconstruction still requires manual work.
burdens.consequence: Open candidate consumes research attention without a decisive disposition.
burdens.resolution_condition: F1 reaches kill or survival threshold on frozen 5-case corpus.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Execute incumbent-only F1 with frozen oracle.

burdens.statement: Semantic file-handoff breakage remains a hypothesis at the unregistered file-to-process boundary.
burdens.target_transition: A frozen 10-case corpus establishes whether incumbent workflows already produce the same accept/reject/correct decision.
burdens.consequence: Building before this test risks reproducing existing file validators/lineage products.
burdens.resolution_condition: F2 reaches kill/survival threshold.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Execute incumbent-only F2.

burdens.statement: No confirmed external product opportunity exists in the current audited set.
burdens.target_transition: All current candidates either resolve or retain explicit evidence-backed status.
burdens.consequence: Pressure to manufacture a winner can create artificial product work.
burdens.resolution_condition: Do not build solely to remove the empty opportunity state.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Let decisive experiments change the state; otherwise keep NO_MVP.

burdens.statement: The engine and its 1500-world results are not yet pinned to a repository revision and execution receipt.
burdens.target_transition: Code, seed, generator, oracle, and result become replayable artifacts.
burdens.consequence: The work risks becoming narrative context instead of durable evidence.
burdens.resolution_condition: A pinned artifact and independent run exist.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Commit the engine and fixtures; run exact replay.

burdens.statement: Some matching-pattern claims, computational results, and literature distinctions remain conversation-level unless linked to pinned proof/computation artifacts.
burdens.target_transition: Each material claim has a source/proof/experiment artifact or remains explicitly UNKNOWN.
burdens.consequence: Past reasoning can be accidentally treated as established repository evidence.
burdens.resolution_condition: Claim/evidence/experiment lineage is pinned or claim remains unpromoted.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Create a claim ledger with source and exact computational artifacts.

burdens.statement: Root README fetch returned 404 for Wedgettok and la-rouine-platform through the connected file surface, so those repos cannot be declared exhaustively audited from that route.
burdens.target_transition: Current private-repo state is captured through a verifiable source path.
burdens.consequence: A forced 'everything everywhere' sweep could falsely report completeness.
burdens.resolution_condition: Repo-specific audit artifacts are obtained or the repos are explicitly marked coverage-unknown.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Use available repo-native/current artifacts or local mounted copies for direct audit.

burdens.statement: The current README is only an identity-level surface, while multiple research branches/frontiers exist outside that README.
burdens.target_transition: Active research frontiers are represented by current source refs, evidence status, and next discriminating tests.
burdens.consequence: Branch proliferation can become invisible context debt.
burdens.resolution_condition: A current frontier index is generated from the repository itself.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Build a repository-native current frontier index.

burdens.statement: Legacy repositories contain multiple historical copies, benchmark claims, TODOs, and over-complex runtime ideas.
burdens.target_transition: Only retained primitives with explicit source/evidence lineage enter the active system.
burdens.consequence: Historical copies can re-enter as false current authority.
burdens.resolution_condition: Use the salvage audit as disposition boundary; do not revive stale claims without new evidence.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Attach provenance record whenever a legacy primitive is imported.

burdens.statement: A large portion of work can require repeated reconstruction of why a decision, experiment, or limitation exists.
burdens.target_transition: Continuation starts from machine-readable frontier records rather than conversational memory.
burdens.consequence: Repeated context recovery consumes attention and risks status drift.
burdens.resolution_condition: Canonical transition/burden indexes become the continuation surface.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Complete deterministic regeneration and use the indexes as the default continuation input.

burdens.statement: The same conceptual question can be retested under different names or repositories without shared identity.
burdens.target_transition: Equivalent verification targets share a stable transition/claim identity and can reuse prior negative evidence.
burdens.consequence: Research cycles waste effort rediscovering killed paths.
burdens.resolution_condition: Every new experiment links to prior target/claim identities before execution.
burdens.next_discriminating_action: Make lineage_ref mandatory in new verification records.
